scope: Independent public web archives checked for Blue Scholars website captures, linked posts, and supporting material.

captures.notes: Squarespace homepage; same site identity and main image as the 2021 reference.

Twenty visible post cards and 51 image references. Eighteen internal post permalinks were checked against Arquivo.pt version history; zero additional captures were returned. The corresponding article HTML is already present from Common Crawl.

Archive.today / Archive.ph.discovery: The domain listing identified one saved homepage, titled Blue Scholars - Official Site, redirected from www.bluescholars.com.
Archive.today / Archive.ph.access_limit: The first listing request succeeded; subsequent requests to archive.ph and its tested mirrors returned HTTP 429 CAPTCHA/security pages. The snapshot is recorded as a lead, not as acquired content.

full_text_search.result: Related archived social/profile results were found.

captures.status: Viewed in browser; source HTML not separately acquired.
captures.observed: Profile identifies Seattle, links the band website, describes Sabzi and Prometheus Brown, and shows archived 2009 posts. The profile page is related historical context, not one of the three site designs.

Archive-It.global_cdx: The documented /all endpoint returned HTTP 403. The public full-text search and an individual replay were still usable. A collection-specific CDX request returned an interactive session-verification page to the command-line client.

Library of Congress Web Archives.url_replay_test: The documented wildcard URL replay endpoint returned HTTP 403 from this environment.
Library of Congress Web Archives.conclusion: No catalog record was found, but the separate URL replay interface could not be queried; this is not an archive-wide absence finding.

UK Web Archive.result: The URL lookup redirected to an error page. The University of Edinburgh's web-archiving guidance states that UK Web Archive captures have been unavailable since March 2025 following a cyber attack.

Australian Web Archive / Trove.result: Trove search and replay entry points returned the site's Anubis anti-bot page; no Blue Scholars capture result was obtained.

Ghostarchive.result: The exact homepage query returned 'No archives for that site.'

image_recovery.missing_reason: The 2024 Wayback URL resolves to a 114-byte HTML /lander redirect, not image bytes. Exact URL searches in Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2009-2010 and Arquivo.pt returned no image capture; do not bypass the lander.

presentation_limitations: Four entries have no standalone post response. Their original `.entry` blocks are served as clearly labeled derived views from the October 2011 front page; separate comment threads remain unavailable.
